articles.title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
articles.description: No reason has been given for the withdrawal, but it follows a major incident last week when police were alerted to "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase.

articles.title: Polanski banned from Israel after party's motion declaring 'Zionism is racism'
articles.description: The vote has caused divisions among figures at the top of the party at its conference in Brighton.

articles.title: Protesters scuffle with police as migrants brought ashore on south coast
articles.description: The Home Office said 149 migrants were brought ashore and taken by coach to a processing centre in Kent.

articles.title: Shadow chancellor to unveil Tory plans to cut taxes and regulations
articles.description: Shadow ministers will unveil a series of policies on day two of the Conservative Party conference in Birmingham.
